profit_quality.assessment: The group is not a clean net-cash education company. Education operations generate cash, but 2023 reported profit was negative because the TV/film business produced major receivable and project impairments. Operating cash flow was RMB373.9m and total property/equipment capex was RMB254.2m, leaving only about RMB119.7m before additional working-capital and control-path caution. The main denominator is therefore a conservative RMB120.0m pre-haircut owner-distributable cash profit, discounted by 0.45 to RMB54.0m.
adjustments: Do not use 2023 reported parent net loss of RMB196.3m as sustainable cash loss, because ECL impairments are non-cash.
Do not fully use education segment adjusted profit, because entertainment/livestreaming remains loss-making and historical TV receivables show poor cash conversion.
Treat 2023 total capex as a real claim on cash; maintenance versus growth capex is not disclosed.
Contract liabilities from education are cash received in advance for future services and reduce distributable capacity.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 operating cash flow RMB373.895m less property/equipment capex RMB254.159m gives roughly RMB119.736m before intangible purchases and financing distributions.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent reported loss, severe TV/film receivable impairment, PRC/VIE education cash restrictions, and large university capex require a low cash-profit haircut factor.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Operating cash flow was positive, helped by tuition prepayments and contract liability increase; receivable impairment indicates weak conversion in TV/film.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Annual report discloses RMB254.2m property/equipment purchases primarily for the University but does not split maintenance and growth capex; main estimate keeps only RMB120.0m pre-haircut distributable cash profit.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 working capital included receivable increase of RMB68.9m and contract liabilities increase of RMB75.8m; contract liabilities are not freely distributable cash.
